fdroid:app.marmalade.stt.name: Marmalade STT
fdroid:app.marmalade.stt.summary: Private, offline speech-to-text for your keyboard. Your voice stays on device.
fdroid:app.marmalade.stt.description:
Marmalade STT turns your speech into text on your phone. Use it as the voice input of your keyboard (FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, FlorisBoard and others), and of apps that ask Android for speech input. Your voice never leaves the device.
 Private. Speech is recognized on the phone. Audio is never saved or uploaded
 Offline. After a one-time download of a speech engine, it works without a connection
 Live text. Shows your words in real time as you speak, on most engines
 Knows when you're done. Smart Turn, the default for the speak-now popup, waits until you sound finished, so a pause to think rarely cuts you off
 Multilingual. 100 languages, with the best engine for yours picked automatically
 Clean output. Filler words removed, numbers as digits, your own replacements and verbal snippets
 Free and open source. No ads, no accounts, no analytics
 PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
 No analytics, no tracking, no crash reporting, no accounts, and no server of ours. The internet is used only to download the speech engines you choose, from GitHub, and every file is checked against a pinned SHA-256 hash. Android backup is turned off, so nothing is copied to the cloud.
 YOU DECIDE WHEN IT STOPS 
 In the speak-now popup and other apps, Marmalade uses Smart Turn v3 technology by default to detect when you have finished speaking. No hands required. Does it cut you off too early? Switch to stopping at a pause, or set an end word instead. On the keyboard it listens until you tap, or it can use Smart Turn too.
 CLEAN TEXT 
 Optional cleanup fixes capitals, and in English removes filler words, turns "new line" and "period" into the real thing and writes numbers as digits. Replacements for names the engine gets wrong, and snippets for text you type often, work in any language.
 WORKS WITH YOUR KEYBOARD 
 Turn on "Marmalade voice typing" and your keyboard's mic key opens a small Marmalade panel that types what you say. It works with FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, FlorisBoard, AnySoftKeyboard, Unexpected Keyboard, AOSP's keyboard and others with a voice key.
 AN ENGINE THAT SUITS YOUR PHONE 
 The setup guide recommends a speech engine for your language and for your phone's memory and speed, with the option to download and try out other models.
 LANGUAGES 
 Fast engines cover English, Bulgarian, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Latvian, Lithuanian, Maltese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Slovak, Slovenian, Spanish, Swedish, Ukrainian, Japanese, Hindi, Arabic and Vietnamese. Chinese and Korean get Qwen3-ASR, lighter than Whisper. You can also pick it for its 28 other languages, English included. Other languages work through Whisper Large v3 Turbo, with more delay.
 OPEN SOURCE 
 Marmalade STT is MIT licensed. If you'd like to support it, Settings → Support links to GitHub Sponsors; the app is the same either way.

fdroid:com.marlinid.marlin.description:
Marlin: Marine Species ID & Life List
Ever spotted a fish, ray, or jellyfish while diving or snorkeling and wondered what it was? Marlin helps you identify marine life on the spot, learn more about it, and build your own personal life list of every species you encounter.
Spot it, look it up, and add it to your life list — built for everything that lives in the ocean.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
Identify species near you
See which marine species are commonly recorded near your current location, or anywhere you choose, powered by real observation data from the iNaturalist community.
Search and learn
Look up any marine species by name, or explore by classification, tapping through families and groups to discover related species. Each species page brings together photos, a range map, a seasonality chart, a Wikipedia summary, and IUCN Red List conservation status.
Build your life list
Log every sighting with notes, photos, and a precise location. Your life list keeps a running record of every species you've encountered, ready to revisit any time.
See your sightings on a map
"My Map" plots every sighting you've logged, color-coded by group (fish, sharks and rays, mollusks, jellyfish, marine mammals, and more), so you can see where and what you've found at a glance.
Make it yours
Choose a light, dark, or system theme, and set a manual location for logging sightings from a past trip.
PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Marlin doesn't ask you to create an account. There is no tracking, no analytics, and no advertising. Your life list, photos, and notes stay on your device, under your control, with manual export/import whenever you want it.
Whether you're a diver, snorkeler, beachcomber, or simply curious about what's living in the water near you, Marlin turns every encounter into something you can identify, learn from, and remember.

 Last messages preview: Blurs all message previews on the left.

firefox-addons:2707951.name: Definer: Word Translator, Ask AI, Popup Dictionary
firefox-addons:2707951.summary: Select text to translate, define, or ask AI. A word translator and dictionary extension for webpages, PDFs, and EPUBs.
firefox-addons:2707951.description:
Read the articles and books you want in another language, with help close to the text. Definer is a popup dictionary and word translator that brings definitions, contextual translation, pronunciation and AI explanations beside your selection. Get a quick answer, explore an interesting expression or keep something useful for later learning.
KEY FEATURES
📖 Dictionary meanings, examples, synonyms and related words
🌍 Translate selected words, phrases and passages in context
🎧 Text to speech, pronunciation recordings and video examples
🤖 AI explanations, writing help and reusable prompts
🔎 Image search, Wikipedia and your own dictionary sources
📚 PDF and EPUB Reader with a personal library
🗂 Lookup History, editable vocabulary and Anki export
🖱 Open a lookup beside your text
Select text with the mouse, then click the small round Definer icon that appears. You can also use a keyboard shortcut or the Definer command in the right-click menu. Prefer looking up words with a double-click? Enable double-click lookup in the popup settings.
🌍 Understand the sentence and explore the word
A translation helps you follow the passage; a dictionary helps you get to know the expression. Translator's In Context section translates the surrounding sentence or paragraph and highlights your selected expression. Compare alternative translations to find the wording that fits the passage. Open the dictionary for meanings, usage examples and related words, then compare those examples with the sentence you are reading. Follow a related term into another lookup when you want to explore further.
📖 Use your preferred dictionaries
Add a website dictionary as a Custom source or import a supported Offline Dictionary file. Keep a trusted learner's dictionary or specialist reference alongside the included resources.
Choose the language of the answers as well as the language of the text. Keep dictionary explanations in your study language beside a translation into your own language, or choose another result language for a particular resource.
🔎 See what the words refer to
When a passage mentions an unfamiliar musical instrument, a translated name may still leave you guessing. Look at pictures from Open Images' openly licensed cultural collections, then open Wikipedia to learn about its history or role. Explore pictures, background information and definitions in the same lookup.
🎧 Connect the written phrase with its sound
Listen to a word or selected passage with text to speech. Compare pronunciation recordings from Wiktionary, or use YouGlish to hear the expression in videos. A phrase you recognize on the page may sound quite different in conversation: hearing its stress and rhythm gives you something concrete to listen for next time.
🤖 Reuse the kind of AI help you need
Ask why a tense is used, what makes a remark sarcastic or how to make your own sentence more natural. Follow up on the part of the explanation you want to understand better. AI can also summarize selected text or help revise its grammar and tone.
Save your usual instructions as prompts: one for grammar at your level, another for a more polite reply. These prompts appear as separate tasks, each with its own conversation for that lookup. Return to the grammar explanation after working on the reply, then reuse either prompt with the next passage.
🗂 Build editable vocabulary and flashcards
Save the information that made an expression useful to you: dictionary meanings and examples, a contextual translation or a helpful AI conversation. Organize it in Collections by book, language or subject, then edit the content in your own words.
Recipes let you choose how available results become study material. A custom card can put an example on the front and combine a dictionary meaning with a translation on the back. Once that layout suits your study method, reuse it for later discoveries instead of rearranging each card by hand.
📚 Continue a book in the PDF and EPUB Reader
Open course materials, papers and ebooks in Definer's Reader and use your chosen lookup sources inside the document. Books stay in a local library with your reading position, ready for the next session.
In an EPUB, move between chapters and adjust the text size. In a PDF, search for a passage, highlight it or add a note. PDF annotations save to the library copy, and you can download an annotated copy to keep or share.
🖥 Optional Desktop app for Windows and Linux
For text in an image, screenshot, app or game, the separate Definer Desktop app adds screen OCR and text recognition. Start Word from its tray menu and click a word, or start Region and drag around a passage. Configured shortcuts offer another way to start. The recognized text opens in Definer's lookup tools, ready for a translation, definition or AI question.
❓ FAQ
Can useful phrases be saved after finishing a chapter?
Yes. With History recording enabled, reopen recorded lookups in History to revisit their available results and original page context. Choose the expressions worth keeping and save from those results when you are ready. You can finish the chapter before deciding what belongs in your vocabulary collection.
How can saved vocabulary be exported?
Send flashcards to desktop Anki through AnkiConnect, export Markdown files for notes, choose CSV for a spreadsheet or use JSON for structured data. You can export selected items or whole Collections, so a particular project can travel with the material you chose for it.
🛠 QUICK HELP
If Definer stops responding, restart your browser. If the lookup popup does not appear, check that your chosen activation action is enabled and that Definer is enabled for the current site. You can also click Definer in the browser toolbar, type a word or phrase and press Enter for a manual lookup.
For a continuing problem, email definer@lumetrium.com with your browser name, the affected page and a short description of what happened.
📬 CONTACT & COMMUNITY
Questions, bug reports or ideas: definer@lumetrium.com 
Discussion and updates:
 https://www.reddit.com/r/lumetrium_definer 
Guides and customization examples:
 https://lumetrium.com/definer/wiki

Watch YouTube videos in your language with natural real-time dubbing, without needing to read subtitles.
FyDub translates the audio of YouTube videos while they play, using natural voices synchronized with the original content. No pausing, no reading, and no complicated steps: just open a video, click “Translate Video,” and FyDub will instantly generate dubbed audio synchronized with the original content.
⸻
✦ KEY FEATURES
🔄 AI-powered synchronization and translation — the dubbed audio dynamically adjusts its speed to stay aligned with subtitles in real time.
🎙 Dubbing with natural voices
🌍 Translate from any language — listen to videos in up to 27 languages with natural male or female voices
🔊 Full control — independently adjust the volume of the original video and the dubbed audio
🎛 Side panel controls — change language, voice, and settings without leaving the video
🔍 Search translation — discover videos in any language and listen to them in yours automatically
🌐 Interface in 27 languages — use the extension comfortably in the language you understand
⸻

 Click the “Translate Video” button below the player.
 The video will start syncing and translating into your language in real time.
 In the side panel, you can change the language, voices, original video volume, view your free usage, or upgrade to Premium for unlimited translations.
✅ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bAqXG4WfgUY 
✦ SEARCH TRANSLATION — HOW IT WORKS
Find more global content: type your search in your language, and FyDub automatically translates it to show you videos in other languages.
 Search normally in your language.
 Once the results appear, the “Translate Search” button will also appear.
 Click the “Translate Search” button.
 Choose the language you want to translate your search into.
 You will see results in the selected language.
 Each video will show:
 Original title
 Title translated into your language
 Select the video you want. Once the video opens, click the “Translate Video” button.
 Audio translation into your language will start automatically.
⸻
✦ FREE AND PREMIUM PLANS
Free plan:
Minutes per month + minutes per day
No account or credit card required
Premium:
Unlimited translations, all languages, all voices, and the full real-time dubbing experience
⸻
✦ PRIVACY AND TRANSPARENCY

We use an anonymous device identifier to manage usage limits and restore access — no personal data, no account required, and no tracking across websites.

firefox-addons:2962122.summary: AI webpage translation with Surplus, OpenRouter and Gemini. Search up-to-date models, sort newest first, and compare provider prices. Compact mobile layout. Bring your own API key.
firefox-addons:2962122.description:
Translate webpages and selected text with AI while keeping page formatting. Bring your own Surplus Intelligence, OpenRouter or Google Gemini API key.
Choose models easily:
- Search by model name, ID, gateway or upstream provider.
- See new models first, with release dates when supplied or provider catalogue dates otherwise. Unknown dates appear last.
- Filter by provider or model family. Other sort options include price and name.
- Auto provider mode compares current eligible routes for your selected model. Auto model mode chooses a current Gemini Flash model.
Designed for Firefox desktop and mobile:
- Compact language and provider controls.
- A stable search field and bounded scrolling model list.
- API keys, advanced instructions and catalogue settings stay in Settings.
- Fast page-context startup, corrected Gemini thinking settings, and improved stop/error handling.
Getting started:
1. Open Settings and add your provider API key.
2. Choose the target language, provider and model.
3. Click Translate page, or highlight text and choose Translate Selection from the context menu.
The extension is free. Provider API usage may require paid credit and is billed by the selected provider. Displayed prices are estimates. Surplus chooses healthy trusted providers by price; you can set an optional minimum discount in Settings. The accidental 81% default from 1.17.0 is corrected in 1.17.1, with the old value retained locally for rollback.
Only the text/HTML needed for a requested translation is sent to the selected provider. Your API key authenticates directly with its corresponding provider. Public model catalogues receive no page text or API keys and cannot load executable code. There is no analytics or telemetry. Normal-browsing translations may be cached locally; private-browsing page caches are disabled. See the privacy policy for details.

firefox-addons:763140.name: AccessURL
firefox-addons:763140.summary: Share access to websites without giving away your username and password. Share access with an Access URL instead.
firefox-addons:763140.description:
Securely share access to online accounts with colleagues, family, and friends without revealing your password. AccessURL gives you a secure URL that shares your online account, lets you control how long you want to share your account for, and lets you revoke access later.
AccessURL also lets you securely ask for access to websites via URL or email. The other person can share their account in one-click, without revealing their password.
Use AccessURL to:
- Share your Facebook account with your friend, without telling her your username and password
- Get your friend to proofread that paper you're writing
- Let your colleague send that email for you
- and so much more
Security is very important. That's why AccessURL encrypts session data with AES-256. That's also why AccessURL lets you set an expiration on Access URLs.
Only send Access URLs to people you personally know and trust. Only use it for websites which allow you to share accounts. 
You can also use AccessURL to ask for access to websites from someone you know. 
Note: AccessURL currently does not support Incognito mode. If you'd like to test it out, use two copies of Firefox on the same computer or try it with multiple computers.
If you have any questions, reach out to support@accessurl.com.

apple-macos:802041071.description:
Device Care is specifically designed for you and lets you easily manage your iPhone / iPad at any time, including the following major features:
- Battery and System Analysis
- Network traffic monitoring
- Network Device Scanner (Anti-Freeloader Detection)
- Network Speed Test
- QR code and barcode scanner
- NFC Tools
- Bluetooth Device Finder: locate multiple Bluetooth devices (earbuds, speakers) and save them for future use
- All-in-one Cleaner Guru
- Privacy Vault
- 100+ Widgets
- Photo Toolkit: GIF maker, Live Photo GIF maker, Photo GPS editor, Photo compression, Photo EXIF viewer
- Charging Animation
- Offline Games: Minesweeper, Snake, Sudoku on iPhone/iPad; Minesweeper, Snake, and Ping Pong on Apple Watch
- Support for Apple Watch
Stay informed about your iPhone and iPad with useful tips and solutions for any issues you encounter, and keep your device running at its best!
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
Detailed features:
• Battery and System Analysis
- Hardware Information: Accurately retrieve phone and tablet specifications to help determine whether the hardware is original or has been replaced.
- Battery Health: Monitor key metrics such as battery capacity and cycle count. Keep a history of test results and visualize changes over time to track battery health.
- Battery Life Analysis: Break down battery life across multiple dimensions and analyze power consumption in detail.
• Network traffic monitoring
- Set your data plan: track total data allowance and daily usage
- Data usage alert reminders
- Daily traffic usage
- Monthly traffic overview
- Data unit display supports megabytes (MB) and gigabytes (GB)
• Network Device Scanner (Anti-Freeloader Detection)
- Scan your current network and display all connected devices, so you can instantly see if any strangers are piggybacking on your Wi-Fi. Highly recommended—download and try it for free! (^_^)
- Supports device tagging and lets you blacklist unwanted devices directly.
• Cleaner Guru
- One-tap automatic smart cleaning for duplicate photos, GIFs, Live Photos, videos, and screenshots.
- Duplicate photo detection scans your gallery using advanced image comparison algorithms. It not only finds exact duplicates but, more importantly, identifies similar photos to help you manage your library and free up storage space. Give it a try! (^_^)
- Detects and removes duplicate videos.
- Detects duplicate contact information, including repeated names, phone numbers, and email addresses.
- Cleans up calendar spam by removing junk invitations and advertisements.
• Widgets
- Dashboard for device status and network info
- 100+ clock styles
- Launchpad: WeChat, Weibo, Facebook, Twitter; one-tap FaceTime, messages, or email; map pins and websites
- Show custom photos
- Disk space
• Privacy Vault
- Protect photos, videos, voice memos, contacts, notes, files, and passwords
- Pattern lock, PIN, Touch ID, Face ID
- Cloud backup for private contacts and notes
- Disguise the app icon
- Flip device face-down to switch apps instantly
• Apple Watch: iPhone battery, current data use, daily usage this month
• Other features
- Disk storage monitoring
- Safari Browser AdBlock
- Decibel meter
- GPS altimeter and barometer (altitude, pressure, coordinates, compass)
- Live memory monitor
- Screen tests
- Countdown days: track important dates, repeat yearly, monthly, or daily
- iPhone flashlight with SOS, iPad night light, touch magnifier
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

apple-macos:6771283790.name: HostBook - Rental Finance
apple-macos:6771283790.description:
HostBook is the financial operating system for co-hosted short-term rentals.
Built for Airbnb, Vrbo, and Booking.com hosts who split income with co-hosts, manage multiple listings, and need complete clarity on where the money actually goes.
HostBook tracks bookings, expenses, co-host payouts, recurring rent, shared costs, multi-currency income, and portfolio profitability — all in one calm, native Apple experience.
No spreadsheets. No bloated accounting software.
— CO-HOST PAYOUTS, DONE PROPERLY —
This is where HostBook stands apart:
Percentage-based revenue splits
Fixed per-booking payouts (Pro)
Tiered rates for short vs. long stays (Pro)
Shared expense pass-through (Pro)
Effective-date rules for agreements that change over time
The Co-host Payout view shows who owes who, how the numbers were calculated, what was already paid, and what remains outstanding.
— TEAM ACCESS —
Invite co-hosts and control what each one sees and does, listing by listing.
Shared calendars, personal reports and fee shares, booking and expense requests that wait for your approval — with real-time notifications.
Available with the Team plans, which include everything in HostBook Pro and add co-host seats.
— UNDERSTAND YOUR PORTFOLIO —
Net profit dashboard with month-over-month comparisons
Waterfall reports: Gross → Expenses → Co-host → Net
Profit & loss and co-host statements
Tax-year reports from your own start date, plus last year and quarters
Occupancy, ADR, and booking performance insights
Year-over-year comparisons and channel breakdowns
— BUILT FOR REAL HOST WORKFLOWS —
Track bookings, expenses, rent, reimbursements, and platform fees
Each transaction in its own currency — now including AUD, NZD, CAD, and CHF
CSV, PDF, and HTML exports
Accountant pack: the CSV and every receipt photo in one zip
Automatic weekly backups to a folder you pick once, keeping the last 8
Listing colors and a full audit log of every change
— PRIVATE BY DESIGN —
HostBook is offline-first. Your data stays on your devices and syncs through your personal iCloud account across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
No analytics. No tracking. We do not collect your financial data and cannot see your transactions.
Optional Team Access syncs only what you choose to share with the co-hosts you invite.
— FREE VS. HOSTBOOK PRO —
Free: 1 listing, 30 transactions in total (deleting one does not free a slot; sample data does not count), 15 guests, and 1 co-host on a percentage split.
Free for everyone: all reports, every export, the accountant pack, backups, multi-currency, and the audit log.
HostBook Pro unlocks:
Unlimited listings, transactions, and guests
More than one co-host, with fixed, tiered, and pass-through fee rules

firefox-addons:3132326.description:
Check the page you're on for accessibility issues in one click, then go further than an automated scan.
 Scan this page 
- Runs the open-source axe-core engine (rules for WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2, levels A and AA) right inside the page you are viewing. Content inside frames (iframes) is not checked.
- Results are grouped by impact: critical, serious, moderate and minor.
- Every issue shows the number of elements, each element's selector and a short HTML snippet.
- Plain-English explanations and copy-ready fix snippets cover 25 of the most common issues (missing alt text, unlabeled form fields, empty buttons and links, low colour contrast, page language and title, ARIA mistakes, small targets and more). Other issues show the engine's own help text.
- A Highlight button scrolls to the element and outlines it on the page.
- Items the engine cannot decide are listed separately as "Needs review".
 Manual checks 
Automated tools find only part of the accessibility issues on a page. The extension includes a checklist of key WCAG 2.2 A/AA checks that need a person: keyboard-only use, visible focus, focus order, 200% zoom and 400% reflow, meaningful alt text, captions, error messages, moving content, accessible sign-in, consistent help, status messages, drag alternatives and more. Each item has a one-line how-to. Mark it pass, fail or not applicable and add a note. Your answers are saved for that page in your browser only.
 Client-ready report 
Download a standalone HTML file (or Markdown) with the page address, date, axe-core version, automated results, your manual-check results, fix suggestions and your notes. Add your own name as the preparer. Good for freelancers and agencies who send findings to clients.
 Private by design 
- No account, no tracking, no analytics, no network requests.
- Your scans and notes never leave your browser. The latest 50 scans are kept locally; "Clear saved data" deletes them.
- Only works on the tab you open it on (activeTab).
 Free. Made by Tessellware, a small software company run by Abdullah Waseem in Karachi, Pakistan. Questions and ideas: abdullah@tessellware.com 
The results are not legal advice. Automated tools find only part of the accessibility issues on a page, so please combine the scan with the manual checks.
